summary: Tree is story-structured and plausible for the remaining half of the game on the WI-01..WI-07 baseline (01066db, grounded in understanding.md): simulation, harness, five-band macro world, visual language, audio, sonar/signal bus, HUD/crafting/debug/save already exist, so the plan correctly owns only the remainder. Expanded leaves WI-01a/b/c (section 12 creative pass) and WI-02a/b/c (sections 13/19/20/63 creature framework) are each one independently testable behavior with at most three subsystems, verbatim parent-criteria coverage, correct depends_on order (WI-02b<-WI-02a, WI-02c<-WI-02a+WI-02b; WI-01c<-WI-01a+WI-01b), and WI-01c is the named final proof owner for the shared AC-cp-spoiler. ST-03..ST-08 are deliberately unexpanded expansion tasks, each carrying complete acceptance criteria, an honest scope inventory, concrete split hints, dependencies, and a fresh-session handoff; per the v2 native-tree contract they must be split before their node review can be accepted (receipt status split in a later session), so readiness of the whole plan does not require them to be pre-split. Coverage of the remaining request scope is complete: ST-01 s12; ST-02 s13/19/20/63; ST-03 s11/21/46/47/52; ST-04 s22/36/38/51/60/66/67; ST-05 s23/24/25 win condition and save milestones; ST-06 phase 7 plus s14/15/16/26/35/43/48/58/59 (the previously missing section 26 map overlay and section 43 accessibility controls now have explicit criteria AC-art-map/AC-art-a11y with browser verification); ST-07 phase 8 plus s3/34/39/40/49/53/71 with the 90-120 min claim owned as playtest evidence; ST-08 phase 9 with the section 70 final checklist, fresh-save-to-ending run, spoiler audit, and README, explicitly re-verifying rather than implementing ST-06's presentation items. Dependency order ST-03<-ST-01+ST-02, ST-04<-ST-03, ST-05<-ST-03+ST-04, ST-06<-ST-04+ST-05, ST-07<-ST-06, ST-08<-ST-07 is acyclic and matches every node's depends_on. Integration and final proof ownership is sound: gameplay rules are evidenced headlessly through the shared scenario harness, browser claims through the shared browser harness, and whole-game delivery (section 45 MVP, section 70 checklist, spoiler safety) is assigned to ST-08 as a verify-and-record node whose fixes route through fresh work items, avoiding an oversized fix-everything node. Spoiler containment is a first-class criterion at every level (AC-cp-spoiler, ST-03/ST-05 body constraints, AC-fin-spoiler). No oversized flat work items, no dropped requirements, no duplicate ownership found.
